simple.meaning: שָׁחָה (shâchâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to depress , i.e. prostrate (especially reflexive, in homage to royalty or God).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 175 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 7 more, beginning at Genesis 18:2. Its contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁחָה (H7812).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שָׁחָה (shâchâh) / H7812 is traced through Genesis 18:2, Genesis 19:1, Genesis 22:5, Genesis 23:7 as a generated source-based concept entry.
